saints.name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel
saints.title: Commemoration of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.shortBlurb: The Blessed Virgin honored as patroness of the Carmelite Order and mother of the Brown Scapular…
biography: The feast honors the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title drawn from Mount Carmel in the Holy Land, where the prophet Elijah defended the worship of the true God and where, in the twelfth century, hermits gathered who became the Carmelite Order. They dedicated their life and their first chapel to Our Lady, and looked to her as patroness and mother.

The day is joined to the devotion of the Brown Scapular, a sign of consecration to Mary long treasured by Carmelites and the faithful. The feast, once proper to the Carmelites, was extended to the whole Latin Church.
saints.knownFor: Patronage of Carmel and the devotion of the Brown Scapular.
patronage: those who wear the Brown Scapular

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “Our Lady of Mount Carmel”
